name: Bambuddy (Bambu Lab printers)
summary: HTTP 8080 with live print status kept open.
notes: Bambuddy talks to the printers itself over MQTT on the local network and pushes status to the browser, so the connection stays open for the whole print -- hours, sometimes days. Check the port your deployment publishes; 8080 is the common default. The check accepts any 2xx or 3xx because the entry point redirects to a login.
